title: Capability: magic-item durations (single-lifetime toggles + start_effect binding for item powers)
description: Selected under the user's 2026-10-12 rule (bd memory magic-item-faithful-or-absent): this structure stays TYPED in the SRD pack because a positive engine capability is more likely than not in the near future, so the capability must exist before the re-freeze (eshyra-o9bd.14). Capability contract per ADR 0020 / eshyra-olc5: operation, inputs, exclusions, residual DM interpretation, real binding to the pack fields, provider-neutral execution, state effects, conformance tests exercising the PACK representation, fail-closed for unsupported input. Pack shape is owned by eshyra-o9bd.19.4.6 (PR #656); coordinate field shapes with it rather than changing the pack later. Scope: simple active/inactive item state machines with a printed duration or termination (e.g. Boots of Speed 10 minutes total, Animated Shield 1 minute, light-shedding toggles) execute their timers and terminations through itemState/itemResetExecutor timers, with readiness turning green only when the conformance tests pass. Complex topology (levers, clouds, flying sword, broom) is DM-adjudicated and out of scope.
notes:
STOP CONDITION (user, 2026-10-12): if any KEPT-typed category (economies incl. event anchors, action type, structured equipment prerequisites, kept state machines/duration toggles, grant creature/count/duration/reversion) or any capability bead eshyra-olc5.8-.12 turns out to be particularly difficult to verify in a way that makes convergence unlikely (e.g. repeated review findings in the same kept category, or verification that cannot distinguish faithful from unfaithful cheaply), the captain must SURFACE it to the user with evidence before proceeding - do not keep repairing it and do not silently reclassify it as DM-adjudicated.
RE-SCOPED 2026-10-13 (user): (1) single-lifetime active/inactive item state machines with a printed duration/termination execute their timers through itemState/itemResetExecutor; (2) multi-instance item powers are NOT item state machines (DM-adjudicated) - the DM starts one active effect per instance with start_effect, and this capability makes start_effect validate an item-sourced effect's duration against the TYPED duration on the item's effect in the pack (source.kind item + effect ref), exactly as spell-sourced effects bind to the spell record's duration/concentration; mismatches are refused. Pack prerequisite (owned by eshyra-o9bd.19.4.6): every such item power's effect carries its printed duration as a typed field.
